## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read `CLAUDE.md` and followed the code conventions
- [ ] My changes follow the branch naming convention (`feature/*`, `fix/*`, etc.)
- [ ] I have added or updated tests for my changes
- [ ] All existing tests pass (`pnpm run test`)
- [ ] TypeScript compiles without errors (`pnpm run type-check`)
- [ ] Lint passes (`pnpm run lint`)
- [ ] If I changed the architecture, I updated `CLAUDE.md`
- [ ] All user-facing strings use `t()` — no hardcoded English
- [ ] Interactive elements are keyboard-navigable with ARIA labels
- [ ] Colour is not the only indicator for severity/status
